scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir backend
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml up -d postgres
scripts.migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test --workspace client/web && npm run build --workspace client/web
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:core && npm run test:core && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
